Tired of AI agents that crash, lose state, or block your event loops? Meet Unreal Agent: a lightweight, async-first agent harness built for high concurrency, durable session history, and safe sandboxed tool execution.

Building production-grade autonomous agents is notoriously hard. You have to juggle input deduplication, LLM turns, tool validation, and crash recovery. Unreal Agent solves this complexity by providing a robust, non-blocking framework that manages the entire agent lifecycle seamlessly.

Top features built for systems architects and AI engineers:
⚡ Async-First Coordinator Architecture: Manages event loops and operation dispatch without blocking I/O.
📥 Session-Scoped In-Memory Inbox: Ensures reliable input idempotency across redeliveries and unexpected crashes.
📜 Append-Only Session Store: Versioned storage that fully supports recovery, branching, and historical state forking.
🛡️ Decoupled Tool Execution: Translate tool calls synchronously while executing them safely in asynchronous or remote sandboxes.

Whether you are building resilient long-running coding assistants or executing untrusted tools securely, Unreal Agent gives you a modular, composable harness with a clean separation of concerns.

Check it out on GitHub and start building production-ready agents today:
https://github.com/unreallabsai/unreal-agent

🚀 Stop context-switching across a dozen different enterprise tools just to find one piece of documentation.

If you are an AI engineer or full-stack developer tired of fragmented knowledge bases, check out Open Glean—an open-source AI workspace built on Hydra DB that acts as your team's ultimate second brain. 🧠✨

🔥 The Problem It Solves:
Enterprise knowledge is scattered everywhere—across local files, web pages, memories, and third-party apps. Open Glean unifies multi-source knowledge retrieval, letting you query everything in one place with transparent, inline citations and a dedicated sources panel.

⚡ Key Features Built for Production:
• Deep Research Workflow: Automatically plans a DAG of sub-questions, executes parallel retrieval tiers, and synthesizes findings with a live progress timeline.
• Enterprise-Grade Security: Keeps user API keys secure in AES-256-GCM encrypted, httpOnly cookies with strict endpoint pinning to prevent SSRF vulnerabilities.
• BYOM Support: Easily connect any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, leverage the built-in OpenRouter model picker, and use dedicated web search plugin integration.
• Flexible Scope Switching: Fan out queries dynamically across multiple databases or sub-tenants on the fly.

Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, it gives developers a production-ready blueprint for building secure, scalable RAG applications with advanced multi-hop reasoning.

Stop letting your AI coding assistants guess their way through Android reverse engineering. 🤖📱

Introducing apk-reverse: a specialized agent skill that transforms autonomous coding tools into expert Android reverse engineers by replacing guesswork with strict procedures, failure stop signals, and programmatic validation gates. 

THE PROBLEM:
Mobile security engineers, pentesters, and developers waste countless hours chasing dead ends, fighting signing key mismatches, or misdiagnosing server-side checks as client-side bugs. General AI reasoning often leads to hallucinated patches and infinite failure loops when tackling complex APKs.

WHAT IT DOES:
This toolkit provides a structured, progressive-disclosure skill framework designed to guide AI agents and human developers alike through complex Android APK reverse engineering, security analysis, debugging, and patching tasks. 

KEY FEATURES:
🛡️ Procedure-Driven Agent Gates: Prevents hallucination and premature patching by enforcing environment truth, classification, and control builds before any modification.
📚 Comprehensive Technical References: Covers advanced packing detection, memory dumping, OLLVM flattening, custom linkers, and bytecode patching.
🛑 Structured Symptom Index: Maps known failure modes directly to explicit stop signals and targeted troubleshooting documentation.
⚙️ Parameterized Automation Scripts: Includes a diagnostic environment checker to isolate host tooling health from target app issues.

DEVELOPER VALUE:
Supply your workflows with battle-tested operational guardrails, explicit bypass strategies for packers and native checks, and exact criteria for determining whether an APK can be successfully modified—or if a fallback architecture is required.

Stop waiting for slow JSON streaming loops just to make an agentic "if" statement. 🛑 

If you are building autonomous agents, automated routing systems, or local-first LLM apps, you know the pain: using massive chat models for simple routing and retries introduces massive latency and cost overhead. 

Meet SemIf (TheoLeeCJ/SemIf-OpenJev). It lets you run high-speed semantic conditional logic locally on an RTX 3090 by reading direct model option probabilities instead of generating conversational text.

⚡ Here is why you need it in your stack:
• Decision-Native Readout: Extracts raw option logits directly without generating answer tokens, decoding loops, or messy JSON repair.
• Blazing Fast Shared-State Execution: Prefetches a long state once and branches it across parallel criteria to hit up to 20 decisions per second on an RTX 3090.
• Multi-Backend Support: Run locally via PyTorch/CUDA, Apple Silicon MLX and MPS, CPU via llama.cpp, or straight in the browser via WebGPU.
• Calibrated Confidence: Uses per-workload temperature calibration via out-of-fold fitting to align option scores with real empirical accuracy.

🚀 Perfect for building local enterprise support routers that instantly classify incoming tickets, or enforcing real-time action firewalls in multi-agent systems without adding conversational lag.

Cut your response times to a fraction of a second and run entirely on consumer hardware. 

👉 Check out the repo and drop a star: https://github.com/TheoLeeCJ/SemIf-OpenJev

Even the foundational Linux kernel is evolving with dedicated AI coding assistant guidelines and an ongoing surge in active enterprise and community engagement! 🚀

Building high-throughput cloud infrastructure or custom embedded systems often means hitting walls with low-level bottlenecks, hardware compatibility, and memory management. Without direct access to the core machinery, optimizing performance-critical applications feels like guessing in the dark. 

The Linux kernel (torvalds/linux) solves this by serving as the ultimate foundational core of any Linux operating system, directly managing hardware, system resources, memory, and processes. 

Key features powering the ecosystem:
• Comprehensive hardware abstraction and device driver infrastructure supporting an immense variety of architectures and peripheral devices.
• Advanced resource management including sophisticated memory management, CPU scheduling, and locking primitives like Read-Copy Update (RCU).
• Robust security frameworks featuring Linux Security Modules (LSM), seccomp filters, and kernel self-protection mechanisms.
• Extensive subsystem documentation tailored for specific engineering roles, from kernel developers to hardware vendors and security experts.

Whether you are developing custom hardware device drivers for IoT devices or tuning the network stack for massive scale, mastering these internals is a superpower for systems engineers and platform architects. 💻✨

Explore the source code, check out the new contributor guidelines, and star the repo here:
https://github.com/torvalds/linux
